assignments.title: Product model ko poora banao
assignments.brief: Model mein fillable, scope aur casts lagao.
tasks: `$fillable` mein name, price, stock, is_active rakho
assignments.explain: Scope query ko naam deta hai aur casts values ko sahi type mein badalte hain.

solution.code:
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

class Product extends Model
{
    use HasFactory;

    protected $fillable = ['name', 'price', 'stock', 'is_active'];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'is_active' => 'boolean',
            'price' => 'decimal:2',
        ];
    }

    public function scopeActive(Builder $query): void
    {
        $query->where('is_active', true);
    }

    public function scopePriceAbove(Builder $query, float $price): void
    {
        $query->where('price', '>', $price);
    }
}

interview.q: What is mass assignment and how do you prevent it?
interview.a: `create()`/`fill()` mein user input se unwanted columns set ho sakte hain. `$fillable` allow-list aur validated data se bachav.
Model mein reusable query condition, jaise `scopeActive` -> `Product::active()`.
Value padhte/likhte waqt badalne wale methods, `Attribute::make(get:, set:)` se.
Columns ko sahi PHP types (bool, array, date, Enum) mein badalne ka tareeka.
Ek class jisme model events (creating, deleted...) ka handling rehta hai, aur jo model se register hoti hai.
